current_bottleneck: 289c showed that explicit observation encoding fixes much of the direct observation modeling problem, but the single latent vector still collapses rollout capacity: common structure is now in gate while change-law sharpness, cointegration, and jump scale remain too weak under autoregressive rollout.
last_result_summary: Iteration 121 ran 289c-v0 and improved the Stage A world-model line from 2/11 to 3/11, passing surface, block_ar, and cross_cell_correlation. It improved corr_ratio, rank_ratio, MR ratio, ACF, level KS, and jump scale versus 289b, but change KS stayed at 0/25 and rollout variance remained far below the teacher-forced path.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 289d-v0: keep the deterministic world-model paradigm, but replace the single latent vector with a small latent token/state set updated by a sequence-aware transition.
current_best_model: 277d-v0, 279a-v0, 281a-v0, 281b-v0, and 282b-v0 are the current overall co-frontiers at 5/11 in the two-level reset.
current_best_note: 282b is still the cleanest current Stage B objective frontier at 5/11, but 284b and 285a strengthen the conclusion that the real cap is now the Stage A support object rather than the Stage B weighting law.
